X6.execution: decentralized actors (X5's) and per-node local critics: each node's critic is a separate 64-64 tanh trunk on the node's local view and one-hot identifier with its own output row; nothing in any critic reads the global state
X6.optimizer: separate actor and critic Adam, no gradient clipping, raw rewards (X5's learner)

critic_modes.M: X4's fixed-scale head, V = c * head(x), c = 1 (B) or 7 (S)

X7.execution: X5's: per-node actors on the local view and identifier, one centralized critic on the global state and identifier
X7.optimizer: one Adam step over all parameters with SB3's global gradient-norm clip 0.5 (E1's default learner), raw rewards; groupclip clips actor and critic separately to 0.5 under the same Adam step

critic_modes.normhead: V = c * head(x) with the gradient at V scaled by 1/c^2 (loss on targets / c), c = 1 (B) or 7 (S)
critic_modes.normpopart: E7's PopArt statistics (beta, sigma_min) with the gradient at V scaled by 1/sigma^2 (PopArt's normalized loss)

X8.optimizer: separate actor and critic Adam, no clipping, raw rewards (X4's D-plain)
X8.calibration: Bdeg is arm B with the critic's Adam learning rate multiplied by k; k is chosen before the freeze, on seeds 42-45 (not X8 seeds), as the candidate in {1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32} whose mean ev_train_mc gap Bdeg - B over the eight cells is closest to the S - B gap measured on the same seeds; crossings of the calibration runs are not computed

inference: seed-level jackknife-t over 40 seeds, t(39), primary at 95%; equivalence by the 90% jackknife-t interval within the declared margin; seed-block percentile bootstrap (2,000 draws; X6 seed 20261124, X7 20261125, X8 20261126) secondary
